//: envMode=loose passes all runtime env (DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, vendor/payment keys, etc.) through to tasks so 'pnpm dev|seed|bootstrap' work whether env comes from a .env file or the shell/container. Turbo 2.x defaults to strict, which silently stripped them. NEXT_PUBLIC_* are declared in build.env so the storefront's build cache correctly invalidates when the publishable key changes (they're inlined at build time).
